title: About Unique Visa Services | Raj & Sunita, Manchester
description: Unique Visa Services is an IAA-regulated immigration and visa practice in Manchester, run by Raj and Sunita since 2008.
body: Unique Visa Services is a UK immigration and visa practice based at 61 Mosley Street in Manchester. We have helped individuals, families and employers since 2008.
The practice is run by Raj and Sunita. When you work with us, you deal with them directly, from your first call to the Home Office decision.
Unique Visa Services Ltd is regulated by the Immigration Advice Authority (IAA), registration reference F200700144. You can check our registration on the IAA adviser finder.
